content.title: Australia's Opthea cuts 80% staff, key executives to exit in deal to avert bankruptcy
content.summary: The company, which produces novel therapies to treat highly progressive retinal diseases, said it has laid off 80% of its total workforce.  Chief Executive Fred Guerard and Finance Chief Tom Reilly will step down next month, Opthea added, following the termination of a development funding agreement signed in March.  The firm had also warned in March that if the deal were terminated following its negative clinical trial results, Opthea could be liable to pay investors up to $680 million.
